name: Seedance 2.5

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.placeholder: Describe the video scenes and motions to generate (up to 2000 characters). Enclose character dialogues with double quotes "". Can be left empty when providing reference media.

image.name: First Frame
image.description: Starting image for image‑to‑video or start‑end‑frame generation. Cannot be used together with reference_images / reference_videos / reference_audios.

last_frame_image.name: Last Frame
last_frame_image.description: Ending frame image for the generated video. Must be used together with the starting frame image (image).

reference_images.name: Reference Images
reference_images.description: List of reference images (max 30). Reference via [Image1], [Image2] in the Prompt. Cannot be used together with start‑end frame images.

reference_videos.name: Reference Videos
reference_videos.description: List of reference videos (max 10, total duration ≤ 30 seconds). Reference via [Video1] in the Prompt.

reference_audios.name: Reference Audios
reference_audios.description: List of reference audios (max 10, total duration ≤ 30 seconds). Reference via [Audio1] in the Prompt. At least one reference image or video is required.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Video duration in seconds, valid range 4‑30. Set to -1 for auto‑determined duration (-1 is mandatory for video edit mode).

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Set to 'adaptive' for model‑driven optimal ratio (must use 'adaptive' for start‑end‑frame, edit and extend modes).

generate_audio.name: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Synchronously generate voice‑over, lip‑sync, sound effects and background music.

watermark.name: Watermark
watermark.description: Whether to embed watermark in generated video.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation results.

notes: 字节跳动 Seedance 2.5 旗舰级视频大模型。原生支持 30 秒生成与音效同步，支持多模态参考集（最多 30 张图片 / 10 个视频 / 10 个音频）及首尾帧控制。
